easyPrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Heat Shimmer
description:
At the beginning of your precombat main phase. Summon: G.F. Cerberus triggers, putting a lore counter on it and triggering its third chapter ability, copying the next instant or sorcery spell you cast twice.
Cast Heat Shimmer by paying its mana cost, targeting Biovisionary.
Summon: G.F. Cerberus triggers, copying Heat Shimmer twice, with the copies targeting Biovisionary.
Resolve all Heat Shimmers, copying Biovisionary three times.
At the beginning of your end step, each Biovisionary triggers. Resolve the first trigger, causing you to win the game.

uses.name: Summon: G.F. Cerberus
uses.cardState: with exactly two lore counters on it
